name: Hash Tables
description: A hash table (hash map) stores key-value pairs and provides average O(1) time for insert, delete, and lookup by hashing keys into array buckets. Python's dict and set, Java's HashMap, and C++'s unordered_map are built-in hash tables.
key_points: O(1) average operations, O(N) worst case if many collisions occur.
Perfect for tracking frequencies, counts, or the 'seen so far' history.
Space cost is O(N) — trade space for time.
Keys must be hashable; order is not guaranteed in a map.
how_to_identify: Need fast membership tests, counts, or a mapping between two values.
common_mistakes: Using a list for membership tests giving O(N) lookups.
Not considering that two different keys can hash to the same bucket.
